Brain arteriovenous malformations (BAVM) hemorrhage during pregnancy
outcome: Maternal outcomes using modified Rankin scale (mRS) score
cohort: 16 female patients with BAVM hemorrhage during pregnancy
finding: The study found good long-term maternal and fetal outcomes in ruptured BAVM patients presenting during pregnancy, the majority of whom received BAVM interventional treatment prior to delivery.
mod_finding: All patients had uncomplicated deliveries (69% cesarean and 23% vaginal) with no reports of postnatal cognitive or developmental delays in infants at 2-year follow-up.
